name: Hub Goiás
evidence: Public innovation hub fostering Goiás's startup ecosystem (Goiânia). Manually added 2026-08-23; re-check after post-election embargo. Website inferred (hubgoias.org) — verify.

name: Novo Seed
evidence: Minas Gerais state government relaunched SEED in 2026 with R$15M for a new decentralized startup-acceleration edition (call for proposals to parks/incubators/accelerators, applications open until April 9, 2026), per multiple 2026 government/news sources, even though the on-file seed.mg.gov.br URL returned 404 on every path we tried. [Rebranded Novo Seed (2026-08-23).] [Link now live (2026-08-23).]

name: Bluefields Aceleradora
evidence: Bluefields ran the 5th edition of its corporate acceleration partnership with Construtora Tenda from March to September 2025 and hosted 'Bluefields Summit 2025'; the on-file domain bluefieldsdev.com now 301-redirects to their current live site bluefields.com.br.
priority_tier: MAINTAIN: intrapreneurship-led — few external startups to source

name: TroposLab
evidence: TroposLab is a B2B innovation consultancy that designs and runs equity-free acceleration cohorts on behalf of institutional partners; Sebrae Roraima launched a Troposlab-run acceleration program on 2026-06-16 selecting 15 startups (applications through 2026-07-17), following an April-2025 Sebrae-SP fintech-founder acceleration cohort (20 women-led fintechs) — both within the last 24 months.

name: Fabrica de Startups
evidence: Fábrica de Startups Brasil (Portugal-origin 'FabStart' network, now Brazil-licensed via Gramado Valley) curated the Startup Smart Stage at Smart City Expo Curitiba 2025 and launched its 'Tourism Explorers Serra Gaúcha' acceleration program at Gramado Summit in 2025.
priority_tier: MAINTAIN: checked — findable gap smaller than throughput implies

name: Grupo Rede+
evidence: Dec 16, 2024 blog post confirms Rede+ is accredited by the state Tecnova program (Bahia, Goiás, Sergipe, Maranhão, DF, Ceará) and is actively guiding startups from a recent cohort ('Tecnova III') into further acceleration/funding steps.
priority_tier: MAINTAIN: checked — findable gap smaller than throughput implies

name: Nexus
evidence: Nexus, the innovation hub/accelerator-incubator of the São José dos Campos Technology Park (PIT), opened applications for Batch 26 on 7 Jul 2025 (deadline 5 Aug 2025), with Workshop Day 12 Aug and Pitch Workshop 10 Oct 2025; it holds Anprotec's top CERNE 4 certification and was ranked among the world's five best incubators by UBI Global.
priority_tier: MAINTAIN: checked — findable gap smaller than throughput implies

name: PCT Guamá
evidence: Science & technology park in Belém running a continuous 'empresa associada' residency/selection edital (nº 001/2026, Feb 2026) plus a committee-run 'Espaço Inovação' startup selection, and it joined the Pan-Amazon incubator/accelerator network (Ripa) in 2026.
priority_tier: MAINTAIN: checked — findable gap smaller than throughput implies

name: Startup RIO
evidence: Rio de Janeiro state's flagship digital-entrepreneur acceleration program continues to run, now under startuprio.rj.gov.br and the related 'Hub RJ Startup' edital; the 2025 edition carried a record R$12M investment (up to R$80k/project plus mentorship), with the submission deadline extended to May 30, 2025. The Dealroom-listed startuprio.org domain no longer resolves (DNS failure). [Website updated 2026-08-23: on-file URL now live.]
priority_tier: MAINTAIN: checked — findable gap smaller than throughput implies

name: Liga Ventures
evidence: Liga Ventures repositioned in Aug 2024 as an open-innovation "consultech," but it still operates corporate acceleration programs as a service - e.g. co-running Oxigênio Aceleradora's 19th, AI-focused acceleration cycle with applications through 13 Oct 2024 and program start Jan 2025 - and maintains an active Startup Scanner database (62.7k+ startups) with 2025 sector landscape reports.
priority_tier: MAINTAIN: checked — findable gap smaller than throughput implies

name: Sebrae Catalisa ICT
evidence: National Sebrae deep-tech acceleration program; 2025 edital registrations (extended to March 9, 2025) selected up to 2,000 research projects for a 3-month mobilization phase, followed by 9-month validation and a 12-month scale-up acceleration phase with funding up to R$200k.
priority_tier: MAINTAIN: checked — findable gap smaller than throughput implies

name: Ilhahub de Inovação
evidence: Active Blue Economy innovation hub/accelerator (12-startup portfolio, aiming for 1,000 ocean startups by 2030): led a Brazilian delegation to the June 2025 UN Ocean Conference, partners with Sebrae-SP on the 'Speed Marine' acceleration program, and launched a Blue Economy investment vehicle with Ventiur.

name: Eretz.bio
evidence: Eretz.bio (Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein's biotech innovation arm) has multiple concurrently open 2025-2026 programs: its SUS acceleration program (registrations closed Feb 17, 2026) and Advanced Therapies/PETA program (submissions to Feb 6, 2026), plus an ongoing general biotech/edtech/digital-health acceleration track.
priority_tier: MAINTAIN: checked — findable gap smaller than throughput implies

name: Biominas Brasil
evidence: Biominas is running its 8th round of open applications for the BioStartup Lab pre-acceleration program (up to 14 bio/health/food/green-tech projects selected) and ran a 15-startup Growbio acceleration batch in 2024, plus an open 2025 Premio Inovo call, showing continuous cohort activity.
priority_tier: MAINTAIN: checked — findable gap smaller than throughput implies

name: Arenahub
evidence: Arena Hub is a genuine sports-tech accelerator/innovation hub running the Podium Labs pre-acceleration program plus several challenges. Its Podium Labs 3 page currently shows an open call ('Inscreva-se!' plus a downloadable edital) with a 2025 site footer, and a new national startup challenge with Ticket Sports was announced.

name: Inovativa Brasil
evidence: Site is only temporarily suspended ("Em observância à Lei 9.504/1997", offline 4 Jul-25 Oct 2026) for Brazilian electoral-law compliance, not inactivity; Ciclo 2025 selected ~90 startups (InovAtiva Brasil) plus 30 (InovAtiva Impacto), and Ciclo 2026 applications were open through 22 May 2026, with the program having accelerated 4,400+ startups total across two annual cycles.

name: Impact Hub Sao Paulo
evidence: Runs the GIZ/BMWK-funded 'Hub de Inovação Climática' acceleration program; a March 28, 2025 post confirms a 15-startup cohort selected (with COP30 Belém participation) and R$451,500 mobilized, backed by a June 2025 program factsheet.

name: FGV Ventures
evidence: FGV Ventures (FGV EAESP's accelerator, originally branded 'GVentures' per a 2017 article), Brazil's first university accelerator, which is very active: Batch 21 applications closed July 12, 2026 for a 2H2026 cohort. [Link corrected; profile now fgv_ventures_1 (2026-08-23).]
priority_tier: MAINTAIN: checked — findable gap smaller than throughput implies

name: INCUBATIC
evidence: Runs the JoInT+ 2025/2026 acceleration program (FACEPE Notice 25/2024, Edital 01/2025) with published final selection results for 6-10 Recife-metro startups; biweekly mentorship, 50% in-person/50% online.

name: Oxigênio Aceleradora
evidence: The Dealroom-listed domain oxigenioaceleradora.com.br now 404s, but Porto Seguro Group's Oxigênio Aceleradora is very much alive under oxigenio.tec.br: it ran its 19th acceleration cycle (InsurTech/FinTech/HealthTech focus, in partnership with Liga Ventures) with applications 17 Sep-13 Oct 2024, Pitch Day Nov 2024, and program start Jan 2025. [On-file link corrected (2026-08-23).]
priority_tier: MAINTAIN: checked — findable gap smaller than throughput implies

name: Baita Accelerator
evidence: Baita is an established, real accelerator (200+ startups accelerated over 10+ years, based at the Unicamp science park). It ran an open 'Turma 2025' cohort call with a dedicated selection inbox (baita-selecao-t2025@baita.barbasdigital.net) and separately opened calls for a new regional 'Baita Nordeste' program, though the specific announcement article now 404s.

name: Darwin Startups
evidence: Darwin Startups (Florianópolis) opened registrations for its 15th acceleration batch in March 2024 and ran corporate-partnered batches (e.g. with Randon Ventures) through 2024; on-file domain 301-redirects to darwinstartups.com, which is live and current.

name: BiotechTown
evidence: BiotechTown opened a new call for UFMG biotech researchers in August 2025 (applications through Sept 15, 2025), marking a new operating phase fully managed by Fundepar, following a 2024 public call (001/2024, closed Sept 2024) for technology-transfer partnerships; site reports 31 portfolio startups and R$10.1M deployed over 46 months.

name: Acelera MGTI
evidence: aceleramgti.com no longer resolves (DNS failure). The program is operated by Fumsoft (a real, historically active MG accelerator with documented cycles from 2013-2019), whose current program page says 'Aguardem um novo edital de chamada' (await a new call) with no cohort dates for 2024-2026.

name: Aceleradora de Campinas
evidence: cps.softex.br no longer resolves. The operator, Núcleo Softex Campinas, confirms on its institutional page that it created Brazil's first municipal startup accelerator and ran past cycles in partnership with Baita Aceleradora, but the page shows no current 2024-2026 cohort dates or open call for this specific municipal program.

name: AmazonasCap
evidence: Site is live and describes real acceleration programs (Startup Revolution, university acceleration, corporate innovation). AmazonasCap remained visible in the ecosystem by sitting on the jury for FIESP's Acelera Startup competition (Aug 19, 2025), but its own 'Nossos Projetos' page lists no self-run cohort or demo day more recent than 2023 (São Judas/UniversitasLAB, FMU Acelera Startups).

name: BrazilLAB
evidence: BrazilLAB's own acceleration microsite shows Turma 7 (opened Dec 2022, DemoDay May 2023) as the most recent cohort, with no announced Turma 8 or newer batch found in searches; the affiliated GovTech Seal certification is also explicitly paused for new applicants since Dec 2022 — no confirmed cohort/demo-day activity within the last 24 months despite the org remaining active in other respects (talks, publications).

name: Gema Ventures
evidence: Site is live but reduced to a minimal, generically-titled placeholder ('HOME | Meusite', copyright 2020, no program content); Gema Ventures was Brazil's first B2B-focused accelerator (Start-Up Brasil partner, 18-month program, 8 startups/cohort) but the last verifiable cohort news found dates to 2015 with nothing found for 2024-2026.

name: HARDS
evidence: Site itself still loads and clearly describes a real hardware+software accelerator, but the founding-team bios and footer copyright cap out at 2022, and the most recent cohort news found (3rd acceleration cycle) dates to 2021-2023 with nothing since; no evidence of activity in the last 24 months.

name: ACE Startups
evidence: The on-file domain acestartups.com.br now hosts unrelated Brazilian gambling ('Jogo do Tigrinho') content, but the underlying accelerator (formerly Aceleratech, then ACE/ACE Startups) now operates as ACE Ventures at aceventures.com.br, which ran a 2025 AI investment track (ACE FIP) with applications open through Oct 31, 2025 and an annual ACE Summit event returning in 2026. [Now a VC firm (ACE Ventures), no longer an accelerator (2026-08-23) — removed from accelerator list.]

name: ADIN
evidence: Adin.com.br is a live, correctly-matched site, but it is a B2B data/CRM/marketing digital-transformation consultancy ('OrganicPath' methodology) with over 10 years serving major brands; no cohort structure, mentorship program, edital, or startup-acceleration language found on the site or in search.

name: Acelera Partners
evidence: Domain acelerapartners.com.br no longer resolves. Crunchbase describes the firm as a former Microsoft Ventures/BizSpark partner accelerator in Brazil and explicitly notes it is 'permanently closed'; BizSpark itself was discontinued by Microsoft in 2018, consistent with Dealroom's last_round_year of 2015.

name: BIOMAKE
evidence: biomake.com.br no longer resolves and no accelerator with this name could be found; search results only surface unrelated Brazilian companies called 'Biomake' (a bioprocess consultancy with a closed/inactive CNPJ registration, and unrelated cosmetics retailers), with no evidence any of them ever ran a startup cohort.

name: Be.Here | The Global Advertising Company
evidence: Website behere.com.br is completely unreachable (DNS resolution fails on both http and https), and the entity's own Dealroom name identifies it as 'The Global Advertising Company', an ad agency, not an accelerator; web search turned up no evidence it ever ran startup cohorts.

name: Berrini Ventures
evidence: The domain berriniventures.com now serves an unrelated online gambling/slots site ("AGENOLX"), confirmed on two separate fetches; Crunchbase lists Berrini Ventures (Brazil's first health-focused startup accelerator, founded 2014) as permanently closed, with no evidence of any activity since.

name: BrazilLAB GovTech Seal
evidence: The GovTech Seal is a startup certification (not a cohort-based accelerator program); its official page explicitly states it is 'currently unavailable for new memberships,' with the most recently certified startups dating from December 2022 and no reopening date announced.

name: Business Initiative for Equality
evidence: Iniciativa Empresarial pela Igualdade Racial is a live, active (founded 2015) corporate coalition/CSR initiative promoting racial equity via a risk scorecard, equity index, and best-practices bank in partnership with companies like Fundacao BB — it is not a startup accelerator and runs no startup cohorts, demo days, or editais.

name: Creative Pack
evidence: The on-file domain creativepack.org does not resolve (DNS failure); the actual live site is creativepack.co, which describes Creative Pack as a consulting/venture-builder firm (strategy, corporate innovation squads, AI automation, executive education) rather than a cohort-based startup accelerator — no cohort or demo-day activity found.

name: EMotion Studios
evidence: eMotion Studios describes itself as a 'holding de startups focada em Creator Economy' — it builds and directly owns portfolio companies (e.g. 1BMG, Oinc Filmes) rather than running an external cohort/mentorship acceleration program.

name: Endeavor Brasil
evidence: Endeavor Brasil is a global entrepreneur-support network (mentorship, 'Multiplier' model) that runs an annual recognition/selection process for already-scaling companies (Endeavor Outliers 2026, featuring firms like Omie, Conta Azul, Tractian) rather than a fixed-cohort early-stage acceleration program.

name: FLAGCX
evidence: FLAGCX is a creative/marketing services network and holding of 20+ autonomous companies across Latam ('largest independent creative services network born in Latam'); acceleration is only one of six business pillars, not an external startup-cohort program.

name: GIGatWORK
evidence: Domain gigat.work (and www variant) fails DNS resolution entirely, and no news, LinkedIn, or Crunchbase presence exists anywhere under the name GIGatWORK; appears defunct or never substantively operating.

name: I9Space
evidence: i9space.com.br 301-redirects to an unrelated 'under construction' WordPress site (iaextreme.com.br); a related i9spacelab.com.br domain redirects to the same placeholder. No current web presence, and search only surfaces a Brasília-based 'I9Space LTDA-ME' offering ebooks/mentoring content rather than a cohort-based accelerator.

name: IERA Polo de Oliveira do Bairro
evidence: The on-file website is the municipal government site of Oliveira do Bairro, Portugal, not a Brazilian entity at all -- IERA (Incubadora de Empresas da Regiao de Aveiro) is a real Portuguese municipal business-support incubator/co-working space (not a Brazil-based cohort accelerator), and the dataset's hq_country='Brazil' / city='Salvador' appear to be a data error. No news of incubator activity newer than ~2022 was found.

name: Inkuba
evidence: inkuba.com.br has an expired SSL certificate and is unreachable; corporate records instead identify 'Inkuba Comunicação Ltda' as a Cannes Lions-winning digital marketing/advertising agency (clients incl. Unilever, Nestlé), not a startup accelerator.

name: InovaCity
evidence: inovacity.com now redirects to a GoDaddy 'domain for sale' parked page; no web search results found for an 'InovaCity' accelerator in São Paulo, suggesting the entity no longer has any online presence.

name: Kaleydos
evidence: Site returns HTTP 410 and resolves via parkingcrew.net domain-parking nameservers; cached pages confirm a real Instituto Jatobás "Programa de Incubação e Aceleração de Impacto" that ran at least 4 cohorts ("turmas") historically, but no evidence of any activity, news, or cohort could be found for 2024-2026.

name: Lemonade (Accelerator)
evidence: Domain now redirects (SSL cert mismatch, resolves 200) to fundepar.com.br, the corporate site of Fundepar (Fundep's investment arm), which lists current vehicles (Seed4Science, Arapy, Motirõ) with no mention of Lemonade; the last confirmed Lemonade cohort/Demo Day found in news is the 16th edition in mid-2020, with no later editions found despite targeted searches.

name: Max Grow
evidence: Domain resolves only to a default HostGator hosting-onboarding page (no real site installed); repeated targeted web searches for "Max Grow" as a Brazilian startup accelerator returned zero relevant results, so its existence/identity as a genuine accelerator could not be confirmed.

name: Neo Acelera
evidence: neoacelera.com.br returns a permanent 301 redirect to www.neoquimica.com.br, the site of Neo Química, an unrelated Brazilian generic-pharmaceutical company; web search results describing a "Neo Acelera" accelerator were inconsistent and unverifiable (conflicting descriptions as a health/longevity accelerator vs. an automotive-software firm), so no credible evidence of a genuine active accelerator by this name was found.

name: Organic Exponential Evolution
evidence: Own site frames Organica as a boutique leadership/organizational-transformation consultancy running bespoke, relationship-based engagements with named enterprise clients (Hering, Boston Scientific Brasil, Méliuz) via diagnostics, mentoring and culture work - not an open cohort program with public applications, batches or demo days, despite being labeled an "aceleradora" in some press coverage.

name: Social Good Brasil
evidence: Own website confirms this is an NGO/civil-society organization (founded 2012, UN Foundation partnership) running data-for-good training, leadership programs and an annual festival (2026 edition upcoming) — not a startup accelerator; no cohort, edital, or demo-day activity was found.

name: Spacemoon
evidence: Formerly a Santos-based 'Boutique de Inovação' running an accelerator program for startups; search results indicate it ceased operations in 2021, and its domain (with or without www) no longer resolves at all (DNS failure), consistent with shutdown.

name: Supernova
evidence: The on-file domain now hosts an unrelated telecom/AI/healthcare company (a Vivo-network MVNO with WhatsApp automation and telehealth services) with 19 years of history and no trace of the accelerator; the original 'Supernova Aceleradora de Startups' (Curitiba, 2 cohorts/year, 4% equity) listing on CODEMEC is dated 2014 with no evidence of activity since.

name: Techmall
evidence: Website returns HTTP 410 Gone (explicitly removed). Techmall was historically one of Brazil's larger accelerators (Startup Brasil-accredited, ~400 startups accelerated), but all discoverable coverage of its cohorts dates to 2014-2016 with no evidence of any activity in the last 24 months.

name: The Jump Brazil
evidence: The Dealroom-listed hubgoias.org is entirely unrelated — it belongs to 'Hub Goiás', a state innovation hub in Goiânia with its own accelerator programs (ELEVE II, GovTech, Epicentro), with no connection to Recife. The real Jump Brasil (Porto Digital's accelerator) lives at jumpbrasil.org and has run continuous cohorts of 'Mind the Bizz' pre-incubation and 'Incubação JUMP', including 2025.1 (deadline Feb 23, 2025) and 2025.2 (deadline Aug 15, 2025) editions. [Closed (per review 2026-08-23).]

name: The Raja Valley
evidence: The on-file domain rajavalley.com now 301-redirects to an unrelated grocery/food-store site (owensfoodstore.com), but the same organization operates today as Raja Hub / Raja Ventures at rajahub.com.br, whose 10th-edition 'Launch X' pre-acceleration cohort ran March-May 2025 with open applications and a demo day structure. [Closed (per review 2026-08-23).]

name: Tree Labs
evidence: Domain treelabs.com.br fails to resolve (confirmed via curl/dig against multiple resolvers, including Google DNS); Tree Labs was a real equity-taking accelerator that ran cohorts (e.g. a 5-startup 'primeira turma'), but all findable coverage dates to 2012-2013 with no evidence of any activity since.

name: UNION TEAM - BEASY and ROCKY
evidence: uniom.team 301-redirects to rockyecommerce.com.br, whose footer credits 'Developed By Uniom Team' — indicating Uniom Team is (or became) a software/product studio that built its own e-commerce SaaS product (Rocky) rather than an entity accelerating external startup cohorts; no evidence of any startup cohort, demo day, or open call was found under this name.

name: Webforce Investments
evidence: Webforce Investimentos (formed from the merger of FINVEST and WebForce Networks) is a traditional equity investment/VC firm with a 24+ company portfolio; the site shows no cohorts, batches, demo days, or application processes, so it is not a cohort-based accelerator and accelerator-style activity_status does not meaningfully apply.

name: Youngworks
evidence: youngworks.nl is live but belongs to an unrelated Amsterdam youth-research/advisory bureau with no connection to Brazil or startups; the actual Brazilian 'Youngworks' incubator (a São Paulo entity that searched for and supported viable ventures) is listed by Crunchbase as permanently closed, and no separate live web presence for it was found.

name: hub+
evidence: hubmais.org fails to resolve entirely (confirmed via curl and dig against both the default and Google 8.8.8.8 resolvers, no DNS records at all); cached descriptions and its LinkedIn page describe hub+ as building hybrid innovation hubs offering incubation/acceleration services, but no dated evidence of any recent cohort, edital, or program was found and its primary domain has fully lapsed.

name: iDEXO
evidence: idexo.com.br now 301-redirects permanently to totvs.com (confirmed via curl), but iDEXO itself — TOTVS's open-innovation program/CVC — remains operational: it opened intake for new community startups in 2024 (batch programs lasting ~3 months with mentoring/prototyping support) and its CVC arm led a R$32M Series A into Malga in February 2025. [Not an accelerator (per review 2026-08-23) — removed from target list.]
